note: Both sets read the two temperature charts and both contain several misread points, but Set A is more often on target: its Louisville July high/low (87–88 F), May high (76 F), April low (47 F) and Irvine Aug/Jul mean and high values match the plotted series, and it also captures the text fact that Bowman Field weather data came from DOE/NREL. Set B systematically misreads the Louisville chart (e.g., Jan high 66 F and Jan mean 55 F against plotted ~40 F and ~32 F, Feb mean 56 F vs ~36 F, Jun mean 67 F vs ~75 F, Jun low 55 F vs ~64 F) and adds a vague, misbound Bowman Field 'temperature 63 F' claim with no series. Set A does invent two non-entities ('Weather Data (High)/(Low)') and contradicts itself on Irvine Aug mean/low and Louisville Jan mean, but its wrong count is still lower. Quotes in A are also more traceable to figure and series than B's abbreviated ones.
